law: THE ISTHMUS (khora native/docs/THE-ISTHMUS.md): a language's codec is its UD grammar (UDTokenizer@1 + UDParser@1 in, UDGrammar@1 out). A codec whose treebank licence allows redistribution is committed here with its attribution; one that does not (non-commercial, research-only, unknown) is POINTED AT: its source is pinned by repo, file and sha256, and it is vendored on the machine that uses it, into the local codec cache, never into this repository (scripts/vendor-ud-codec.mjs; nl-eot.mjs loadGrammar vendors it on first use).
